desc: Strike Industries MOD2 Rifle Stock. With a wider cheek rest and overmolded rubber buttstock pad, shooters can really dig into their shoulders for a more comfortable and stabilized shooting experience. For ease of adjusting length of pull, there is a larger lever with large textured accents for a solid grip, reducing the chance of slipping when using under pressure. That same lever is also used to install the MOD2 stock onto the buffer tube, or remove. Pull the front of the lever downwards to install over the buffer tube with ease. Overmolded QD points are available on both side of the MOD2 stock.
